hypotheses.Q1_gaussian_rank4_matches_matrix_energy: Every component's rank-four Gaussian score R-squared is within 0.10 of its trace-cleaned top-four matrix-energy fraction.
hypotheses.Q2_natural_rank4_is_worse: At every layer median natural rank-four score R-squared is at least 0.20 below moment-matched Gaussian R-squared.
hypotheses.Q3_natural_scores_need_more_modes: At every layer median smallest rank reaching natural score correlation 0.90 exceeds four.
hypotheses.Q4_low_energy_tail_is_naturally_amplifie: At every layer median rank-four residual score-variance fraction is at least twice the trace-cleaned tail matrix-energy fraction.
hypotheses.Q5_full_rank_reconstructs_both: Full-rank natural and Gaussian score R-squared are at least 0.999 for every component.
hypotheses.Q6_fourth_moment_gap_is_depth_general: The natural-minus-Gaussian rank-four R-squared gap is negative for every component at all three layers.
